shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,220p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|validated by:\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -80
rg -n \"reanchor\" scripts || true
sed -n '1,130p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|spec anchor|@spec|validated by\" src scripts | head -100
rg --files scripts | sort | rg 'spec|anchor|link'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n \"tool|schema|input\" README.md docs/adding-a-tool.md .specify/spec.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md CHANGELOG.md example/weather-tool.ts | head -160"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '55,110p'
git diff --check
git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test valid tool input pass-through" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main'
